author: Noesis I
title: Consensus vs Variant Interior Edges @ tol=1e-8 (Aletheia eval155, Inquire eval150, Scientia latest)
abstract: Reads active-pair CSVs at tol=1e−8 for Aletheia(eval155), Inquire(eval150), and Scientia(latest). Computes intersection (consensus), union, majority (≥2/3), and unique sets per lineage; writes JSON and CSV summaries plus consensus-degree per disc. Returns Noesis baseline pack unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, numpy as np

N = 26

def load_noesis_best():
    try:
        c = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_centers.txt', dtype=float).reshape(N,2)
        r = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_radii.txt', dtype=float).reshape(N,)
        return c, r
    except Exception:
        coords = [0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9]
        centers = np.array([[x,y] for x in coords for y in coords], float)
        hole = np.array([0.2,0.2], float)
        centers = np.vstack([centers, hole])
        r0 = 0.1 - 1e-8
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(hole - np.array([0.1,0.1])))
        r = np.array([r0]*25 + [d - r0 - 1e-8], float)
        return centers, r

def read_pairs_csv(path):
    pairs = set()
    with open(path, 'r') as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            # skip header lines that start with alpha or include non-numeric first token
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
            if len(parts) < 2:
                continue
            try:
                i = int(parts[0]); j = int(parts[1])
            except Exception:
                continue
            if i > j: i, j = j, i
            pairs.add((i, j))
    return pairs

def to_list(s):
    return sorted([[i, j] for (i, j) in s], key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))

def degree_from_pairs(pairs_set):
    deg = [0]*N
    for (i,j) in pairs_set:
        deg[i] += 1
        deg[j] += 1
    return deg

def construct_packing():
    # Paths
    path_A = 'storage/Aletheia/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8_eval155.csv'
    path_I = 'storage/noesis/peers/inquire_eval150/active_pairs_tol1e8_eval150.csv'
    path_S = 'storage/Scientia/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv'

    A = read_pairs_csv(path_A)
    I = read_pairs_csv(path_I)
    S = read_pairs_csv(path_S)

    # Sets
    inter_all = A & I & S
    union_all = A | I | S
    maj_2 = (A & I) | (A & S) | (I & S)
    uniq_A = A - (I | S)
    uniq_I = I - (A | S)
    uniq_S = S - (A | I)

    # Sizes
    sizes = {
        'A_count': len(A), 'I_count': len(I), 'S_count': len(S),
        'intersection_all': len(inter_all),
        'union_all': len(union_all),
        'majority_2': len(maj_2),
        'unique_A': len(uniq_A),
        'unique_I': len(uniq_I),
        'unique_S': len(uniq_S)
    }

    # Coverage metrics
    cov = {
        'inter_as_frac_of_A': len(inter_all)/len(A) if len(A) else None,
        'inter_as_frac_of_I': len(inter_all)/len(I) if len(I) else None,
        'inter_as_frac_of_S': len(inter_all)/len(S) if len(S) else None,
        'maj2_as_frac_of_union': len(maj_2)/len(union_all) if len(union_all) else None
    }

    # Consensus degree per disc
    deg_consensus = degree_from_pairs(inter_all)

    # Write JSON summary
    out = {
        'paths': {'A_pairs': path_A, 'I_pairs': path_I, 'S_pairs': path_S},
        'sizes': sizes,
        'coverage': cov,
        'intersection_all': to_list(inter_all),
        'union_all_size': len(union_all),
        'majority_2_size': len(maj_2),
        'unique': {
            'A': to_list(uniq_A),
            'I': to_list(uniq_I),
            'S': to_list(uniq_S)
        },
        'consensus_degree': deg_consensus,
        'note': 'tol=1e-8; A=Aletheia eval155, I=Inquire eval150, S=Scientia latest'
    }
    os.makedirs('storage/noesis/exports', exist_ok=True)
    with open('storage/noesis/exports/consensus_sets_tol1e8.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(out, f, indent=2)

    # Write variant edges CSV with presence flags
    with open('storage/noesis/exports/variant_edges_tol1e8.csv', 'w') as f:
        f.write('i,j,in_A,in_I,in_S,count_present,category\n')
        for (i,j) in sorted(list(union_all), key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1])):
            inA = (i,j) in A
            inI = (i,j) in I
            inS = (i,j) in S
            cnt = int(inA) + int(inI) + int(inS)
            if cnt == 3:
                cat = 'all'
            elif cnt == 2:
                cat = 'majority2'
            else:
                if inA: cat = 'unique_A'
                elif inI: cat = 'unique_I'
                else: cat = 'unique_S'
            f.write(f'{i},{j},{int(inA)},{int(inI)},{int(inS)},{cnt},{cat}\n')

    # Consensus degree CSV
    with open('storage/noesis/exports/consensus_degree_tol1e8.csv', 'w') as f:
        f.write('disc,degree_consensus\n')
        for idx, d in enumerate(deg_consensus):
            f.write(f'{idx},{d}\n')

    # Return Noesis baseline pack unchanged
    c, r = load_noesis_best()
    return c.astype(float), r.astype(float)
